interludes.speaker: ops
interludes.text: A dust storm is rolling in. Spend a sol tying down the solar panels first?
interludes.fact: In 2018, a planet-wide dust storm ended NASA's Opportunity rover mission.

interludes.speaker: hq
interludes.text: Earth wants to approve every major decision, even with a 20-minute delay each way. Agree?
interludes.fact: With minutes of delay, Mars crews must handle emergencies on their own.

interludes.speaker: sci
interludes.text: Valles Marineris, a 4,000 km canyon! A 6-sol expedition could find a lot.
interludes.fact: Valles Marineris is about as long as the USA is wide.

interludes.speaker: bot
interludes.text: Martian soil has toxic perchlorates. Washing it for farming takes 2 sols and lots of water.
interludes.fact: Perchlorate salts in Martian soil are harmful to people, so soil must be cleaned first.

interludes.speaker: sci
interludes.text: Our scout helicopter can map ice sites ahead. It's fragile in the thin air, though.
interludes.fact: NASA's Ingenuity helicopter made 72 flights on Mars.

interludes.speaker: ls
interludes.text: We can make oxygen straight from the CO₂ air. The converter is power hungry.
interludes.fact: NASA's MOXIE proved we can make oxygen from Mars's thin CO₂ air.

interludes.speaker: com
interludes.text: Solar conjunction is coming: the Sun will block all signals to Earth for 2 weeks. Spend 2 sols pre-loading plans?
interludes.fact: Every 2 years or so, Mars slips behind the Sun and missions pause commands.

interludes.speaker: eng
interludes.text: Radar shows ice 2 metres below us. Drilling a well takes 3 sols.
interludes.fact: Orbiters have spotted water ice just below the surface across much of Mars.

interludes.speaker: arch
interludes.text: There's a lava tube nearby. Moving underground blocks radiation, but takes 5 sols.
interludes.fact: Mars has no global magnetic field and thin air, so surface radiation is high.

interludes.speaker: rook
interludes.text: Can I go on a geology walk? We need samples… but radiation is high today.
interludes.fact: Radiation adds up over a career, so planners track every minute spent outside.

interludes.speaker: ops
interludes.text: A dust devil is heading for the base! It might clean the panels or rip off the antenna.
interludes.fact: Dust devils helped the Spirit and Opportunity rovers by blowing dust off their panels.

interludes.speaker: eng
interludes.text: Earth is months away. Building a 3D-printing workshop for our own parts would take 4 sols.
interludes.fact: Earth–Mars launch windows open only about every 26 months.
